  • Improve technical vocabulary for interviews and design reviews.
  • Understand architecture concepts at a glance.
  • Build engineering confidence with correct usage.
  • Use System Design terminology precisely in writing and speech.

Glossary Review

Most important terms

Availability, Consistency, Latency, Throughput, Idempotency, Sharding, Replication, Consensus, Circuit Breaker, Observability.

Interview vocabulary

CAP, PACELC, Quorum, Sticky Session, Cache-Aside, Saga, Bulkhead, Blast Radius, Hot Partition.

Beginner reference

Start with sections A–D and Acronyms — they cover 80% of everyday design conversation.

Daily quick lookup

Bookmark the Quick Reference at the end for latency numbers and availability tables.

FAQ

Is this a substitute for a textbook?
No — it's a lookup. Read the PDF Notes or Complete Tutorial for depth.
How was the term list chosen?
By frequency across interview loops, architecture reviews, and production incident post-mortems.

References

Disclaimer

This resource is intended for educational purposes only. Information is compiled from official documentation, academic publications, research papers, industry standards, and trusted educational resources. System Design principles, cloud platforms, distributed systems, Kubernetes ecosystems, and engineering best practices evolve continuously — readers should consult official documentation for the latest guidance and implementation recommendations.
